d: Purv sansad aanand mohan ne bharatmala pariyojna ke tahat nirmit NH-327E saharsa-supaul rod par sarak suraksha ki khamiyon, lagatar ho rahe hadson aur andarpas va phutaovrabrij ki mang ko lekar apna bayan diya hai. iske sath hi unhonne nitish kumar ko lekar prashant kishor ki tippaniyon aur 'nitish sanvad' karyakram par bhi apni pratikriya vyakt ki hai.
